notes.title: Free DLC - Quia Queen of the Night - Celebrating the 1-Year Anniversary
notes.content:
A new skin will be added to the game today!

Quia: "Queen of the Night"

You can access it via menu by selecting it in-game to change the appearance of the character.
The DLC Costume option will store all the character skins added to the game.
You can also use the "Escape Key/Cancel" option in the DLC menu to return to the standard outfit.

Major events or riding will override clothing options. You can activate the dress again afterwards.

Upload is planned in 5 to 6 hours from time of posting.

I hope you have a lot of fun. Enjoy.

Edit: Upload completed. v1.7.0.1

notes.title: Journey of the Forgotten - 1-YEAR ANNIVERSARY UPDATE
notes.content:
Campaign now includes emotional images. The new mount "Shadow Crystal" is now accessible for players who have completed "The Four Crystals". [Quest starts in Wentora]

Fixes/Patches:
- A plant in the new area was displayed incorrectly as a pillar instead
- Fixed a minor bug concerning the flying demon (only in combination with the new area)
- Minor translation fix in JP (Japanese) version
- Emotion changes in the full campaign and boss dialogues
- Added mount to stable, can be accessed from there after completing the quest
- New mount also working with all characters and tested [+reduces encounters]

Please enjoy. Thank you for reading.

notes.title: Journey of the Forgotten - 1-YEAR ANNIVERSARY
notes.content:
The event will start on Monday 10th and it will last for one week.

A new region has been added to the game. It will introduce a new mount that can be aquired.
Requirements: Current content cleared. Talk to the mysterious character in Wentora's pub. The flying demon on the east side of the northern castle can bring you to the secret area.

Didn't have as much time around christmas. Please enjoy the 1st Year Anniversary!

Feature List:
+ New Mount
+ New Quest (and area)
 [about 110 maps now]
+ Character Emotions

Reminder: Do not forget to update your game on Monday or Tuesday to see the changes.
You can also set your game to "Always keep this game updated".

notes.title: Clear-up regarding not receiving payments and Apology
notes.content:
The whole issue is my fault and I want to apologize to VALVE.

It seems that I could not correctly calculate the impact of the double taxation and the rest of the money got hold back because of known thresholds.

I felt very pressured at the time and I am sorry about the way I acted.

Thank you for reading. 


Kind regards
TwoSoulFox Studios

notes.title: Patch and Information regarding Riding
notes.content:
Quality of Life Update 1.6.0.3 is live.

The horse for the player can be obtained going north at the start.

You do not need to be a master of martial arts or reach lvl 60 to use horses and it will help reducing encounters early on.

For people who think moving does not feel like moving, sprint is available (yes, even while riding).

Basic controls can be viewed in Quia's notebook in her room.

notes.title: JOURNEY OF THE FORGOTTEN needs You!
notes.content:
I do not know in what Dream Land you're living but I need money to survive.

These are the current options:
+ Buy the game (and convert your wishlist) ***OVER 300***
+ Tell your friends, family and the neighbours about the game

VALVE is witholding all money from TWOSOULFOX STUDIOS.
I cannot keep working like this.

From this day onward all development is halted. I will not work without getting paid for my sold games.
It is sad to say but game development here is the worst.

Level-0 trolls do not matter but getting the treatment from the platform is outrageous.

I will inform you when I have money to keep working on the game and future titles.
Right now people only want low quality games that steal from ips instead of games that are complete RPGs with tons of hours and love.
Most people will never understand that I did it all alone or what hardships were part of the creation.

Quia will cry now and I will do a real job that gives real money.

I rather die than working without getting paid.

notes.title: Big REWORK and Version 1.5 Changes
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44660319/3da5e97dc99a3e2dc733e7ed8fd44087fb28ea9f.png[/img]

Starting 2024 Journey of the Forgotten received major updates and had its DEMO go live. If you have not seen it yet, check out the new version.

The game received the following improvements:
- new Key Art reflecting game elements more clearly
- new Steam Page better covering the extent of the project
- better screenshots, reworked trailer
- improved tilesets of the entire game
- improved sprites of monsters/enemies
- improved UI and the player is allowed to adapt via "Window Flair"
- improved music and more special pieces all over the game
- "Music Room" with unlockable music pieces from the game
- "Pictures" which works like an Art Gallery and unlocks pictures for achievements
- fixes/patches for small graphical issues and a missing translation
- 3 new bosses for the "endgame" (of the current content)

Journey of the Forgotten is participating in the Steam Next Fest February (5th - 12th).

For Press: There is a Next Fest Pre-Release Event for Press on the 25th

For Players: TwoSoulFox Studios is streaming during these time slots
TWOSOULFOX STREAM #1    _6th 6:00 CET (12th 21:00 PST)
TWOSOULFOX STREAM #2    12th 6:00 CET (11th 21:00 PST)

Enjoy the game and have a great time!
